body.prompt: Exactly the same miniature diorama, same camera angle, same framing, same composition and same objects as the reference image, but on a warm humid summer night. Deep navy night background with a soft gradient, tiny work lights on poles casting warm pools of light, the turbine hall door glowing warm orange from inside, small lit windows, reflective stripes on the hi-vis vests catching light, each worker's tiny wristband has a small glowing green LED. The left third stays empty dark navy for text. Same tilt-shift miniature photography style. No text, no logos.
